# THE ALLOW-LISTS UNDER THE RATCHET (scripts/ci/allow_list_ratchet.py): a row lands only with the check's birth -- a commit
# carrying `New-Check: <what>`, each row `TEMPORARY owner: <who>; remove when <fix>; <why>` -- and otherwise a list only
# shrinks: a finding after birth is fixed, never listed. Every allow-list file in the repository is registered here
# (AllowListRatchetSpec), so a new check's list is under the ratchet from the commit that adds it.
# One path a line; a registered list is a TSV whose last column is the row's reason, its first non-comment line a header.
